messages:
maria.g: Quick question — I'll be on parental leave Dec 20–Jan 10. We have the company blackout Dec 24–31. One of my ICs (Aisha) has 4 days carryover they'd like to burn in that window. Can approvals be delegated while I'm OOO? Who signs the blackout exceptions?

jamal.k: @maria.g you can nominate a delegate but blackout exceptions need people-ops signoff. What does Aisha need? cc @elena.p

elena.p: Short answer: yes you can delegate approval authority, but exceptions to blackout/carryover caps require a formal PTO Exception request reviewed by People Ops. Process: submit the PTO Exception form + manager approval + coverage plan. We aim to respond within 3 business days. Link: https://intranet.redwood/people/pto-exceptions

maria.g: OK thanks. If I nominate Lina as delegate, does Lina need any particular role in the HR portal? Also do we need exec approval for >3 days carryover use?

elena.p: Delegate needs 'approver' role in Workday/HCM. If they don't have it, open an IT access ticket (ops-requests) with subject: "HR role: approver for Lina T — start 2026-12-20 end 2027-01-10". For carryover: >3 days during blackout triggers exception review; exec sign-off only for extreme cases. Required fields for the exception form: employee name, dates, carryover days used, reason, coverage plan, manager name, delegate name. Example template below:

```
Subject: PTO Exception Request — Aisha D. — Dec 26-29
Employee: Aisha D.
Manager: Maria G.
Delegate: Lina T.
Requested dates: 2026-12-26 to 2026-12-29 (4 days)
Carryover balance: 4
Coverage plan: on-call rotation, handoff doc link https://intranet.redwood/handbooks/hand-off-aisha
Reason: family travel + limited leave window
Attachments: handoff doc, manager approval screenshot
```

lina.t: Happy to cover approvals while Maria's out. I'll open the IT request now. Quick Q: can I auto-approve 1-2 day PTO for my reports while you're out or should I route everything through People Ops?

elena.p: Don't auto-approve requests that touch blackout dates or exceed carryover caps. For routine <=2 day requests outside blackout, delegating and toggling auto-approve is fine; we recommend manual review for any carryover. If you want auto-approve enabled, mention it in the IT ticket and include list of employees to include.

simon.m: Folks — if People Ops needs anything from leadership for quick turnaround, ping me. We should avoid blocking team's leave.

maria.g: Thanks all — I've submitted the exception form and tagged @elena.p, and nominated Lina in the HR ticket. Leaving this thread open for confirmation. :pray:
